MICU DAILY PROGRESS NOTE — UPMC
Date: 5/7/2027 (post-TIPS day ~4)

SUBJECTIVE/EVENTS: Fevers persist (Tmax 39.4 C) and she remains on norepinephrine at a stable dose. No further bleeding. Still not waking despite sedation being held.

DATA: Blood cultures from 5/4 and 5/5: no growth to date. Urine culture: no growth. Repeat ascitic fluid (5/5): PMN below threshold, culture pending. Chest X-ray without a new infiltrate. Lines inspected without erythema.

ASSESSMENT/PLAN:
#Persistent fevers + pressor requirement despite 48-72 h of ceftriaxone — presumed sepsis without a localized source. BROADEN empiric coverage to VANCOMYCIN + MEROPENEM (renally adjusted). Continue source evaluation; consider cross-sectional imaging if no improvement.
#Persistent unresponsiveness — hepatic encephalopathy (TIPS-precipitated) vs critical illness; continue lactulose; neurology input if no change.
#Cirrhosis / post-variceal-bleed — serial labs; MELD trending up.
attestation: Electronically signed by Dr. Lena Park, MD (MICU). 5/7/2027.
